from pycompss.api.task import task
from pycompss.api.api import compss_wait_on

@task(returns=1)
def compute_jacobi2D(input, i, j):
    n1 = n2 = n3 = n4 = 0
    if i > 0:     n1 = input[i - 1][j]
    if i < len(input) - 1: n2 = input[i + 1][j]
    if j > 0: n3 = input[i][j - 1]
    if j < len(input[0]) - 1: n4 = input[i][j + 1]

    return (n1 + n2 + n3 + n4 + input[i][j])/5

def main(input):
    output = [[compute_jacobi2D(input, i, j) for j in range(len(input[0]))] for i in range(len(input))]
    output = compss_wait_on(output)
    return output
